title: yaah workflow validate --json report
description: JSON report emitted by `yaah workflow validate --json <spec>` (cmd/yaah/workflow_report.go, kind yaah.workflow.validate.v1). The shape is stable within v1: consumers can rely on the documented fields always being present with these types. errors and warnings serialize as [] (never null). Exit code is 0 when ok is true and 1 otherwise; --strict promotes warnings into failure without moving them out of the warnings array.

kind.description: Report kind discriminator; bumped only on a breaking shape change.

spec.description: The spec path exactly as given on the command line.

name.description: Workflow name from the document (omitted when the document never decoded).

status.description: valid = decoded, resolved, and no error findings; invalid = decoded and resolved into a graph but carries error findings; unresolved = load, decode, or ir.Resolve failed, so node-level families (WF002-WF036) could not run and the load/resolve failure is reported as a synthetic diagnostic.

ok.description: Final verdict after --strict promotion: true iff no errors and (no warnings or not strict).

strict.description: Whether --strict was set; strict treats warnings as errors for the exit code only.

warnings.description: Warning-severity findings (host-relative rules WF030/WF031/WF033-WF036 when they cannot prove a violation on this host).

code.description: Stable rule code from the internal/workflow/validate catalog (see its doc.go).

path.description: Dotted spec path the finding points at (omitted for document-level findings).
